headings.usage: Main headings, section titles, large numbers in stat cards, crest logo text

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, labels, buttons, inputs

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(11, 29, 54, 0.1) for structural elements, enhancing the 'ledger' aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal drop shadows (shadow-sm). Rely more on borders and background contrast.
visual_enhancers.borderRadius: rounded-md (6px - 8px) for buttons and input fields.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat, clean backgrounds. The warm gray gives a subtle paper-like academic feel.

button.style: Solid Teal (#008080) background, white text, rounded-md. This must be the one standard style everywhere for primary actions.
button.hover: Darken teal slightly on hover. No drastic scaling or translating.
button.variants: Secondary buttons can be outlined navy or subtle warm gray backgrounds.

stat_display.style: 'Ledger' style cards: Warm gray or white backgrounds with subtle borders. Large serif numbers (Lora) placed over sans-serif (Inter) gray labels.

logo.style: Circular crest matching ideology of unity + community action.

loading_state.style: Skeleton loaders or subtle spinners MUST be used everywhere data fetches occur.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous spacing: 24-32px (p-6 to p-8) breathing room around headers and main sections.
grids_and_layouts.container: Max-width containers (max-w-6xl) to ensure readability of feeds and forms.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-aligned for textual feeds and forms. Center-aligned acceptable for hero banners and stat grids.

motion.transitions: Subtle opacity and color transitions (200ms ease). Avoid bouncy or exaggerated motion to maintain a professional, academic tone.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Teal text on white backgrounds and white text on Teal backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary_navy/50) on all inputs and buttons.

images.description: Volunteers cleaning up a forest - Good for landing page hero or 'How it works' section.
Diverse young volunteers organizing donations - Ideal for NGO Dashboard empty states or community spotlight.
People sitting on chair in front of table holding pens - Great for Admin/NGO approval sections or 'trust' building.
Colleagues working together - Use for NGO landing page or registration flow.

3d_libraries.reason: The academic and NGO context requires absolute clarity, accessibility, and straightforward information processing. A flat, ledger-style design is far more appropriate.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this by strictly adhering to the typography and layout rules provided.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so write components and files in standard JavaScript + JSX, not TypeScript.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Remember to check if it's installed or use Shadcn's version.
Use Lora (serif) for headings and Inter (sans-serif) for body text.
Buttons must be solid Teal, white text, and rounded. No exception.
Stats must use the 'Ledger' style: large Lora numbers over Inter gray labels.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Always start from mobile-first approach, using fluid typographies.
Ensure high contrast on active/hover states.
Use loading states (skeletons, spinners) actively everywhere data fetches.
Implement clear state indicators (empty states, success states, error states) without relying on cryptic error codes.
